text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! A place where Umamusume show 
their appreciation to the fans who support 
them every day—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Big thx for all the support as always~!! 
Here's the slot for a three-way pic with 
Palmer and Heli☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... would it be okay to take a 
two-shot of Helios-san and Palmer-san...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but why?? You're the tenth 
person today! Does nobody want to be 
center?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Young lady, what pose would you 
like?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-I want to see both of you make a heart 
with your tails...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that makes five times!! Is this a 
trend or something!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then we gotta do it~☆ Palmer-chiiin! 
Strategy meeting!

"Each girl entertained fans in her own 
way, participating in events and firing up 
the crowd... Meanwhile, as for Daiichi 
Ruby—"

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Lady Ruby! She truly is 
gorgeous...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to lay eyes on you from 
this distance... Haaah, I feel so 
blessed...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am aware.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you call upon me, I shall respond 
accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It will soon be time for the competition.

She will be participating in cricket this 
time. It is a traditional ball game 
originating in England, often called the 
sport of gentlemen and ladies.

Normally it takes a long time, but this 
time the match is being held in a 
relatively new 2-to-3-hour format. ...A 
bit late to ask, but—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This is the very event Mother participated 
in during the Fan Appreciation Festival 
back when she was a Tracen student.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So... what you mean by that is...
choice_data_list:
Why She's Giving It Her All for 
Thanksgiving

text_block_list.text:
Since she isn't one to seek interaction 
with fans, it felt a little curious to see 
her participating so enthusiastically in 
today's events.
choice_data_list: So it's as a family, huh.
So it's as a family, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. For our family, it is a necessity.

Cricket is an 11-player team sport that 
demands intense physical stamina and 
cooperation. Neither word really seems to 
suit her, but...

I haven't watched her practice even once, 
nor have I heard anything from her other 
than her report of participating. ...My 
interest was slightly piqued.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I have no further instructions for today. 
Please follow your captain's lead in 
everything."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, starting from learning the 
rules... the team has shown remarkable 
growth in such a short time. Please step 
forward with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Honor the spirit of fair play, and claim 
your victory with grace, like a true lady.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Team
text_block_list.text: Yes!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
In cricket, the manager cannot give 
instructions during a match. After that, 
everything is entirely up to the players.

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a man who's been at this academy 
for a long time. And just a cricket fan... 
who is grateful to Miss Daiichi Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Cricket was once played at this academy 
just a single time. However, the tradition 
died out completely after that, which left 
me feeling rather lonely until...

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
“—Daiichi Ruby appeared. In no time at 
all, she managed to bring the rowdy, 
overly energetic Umamusume together, 
and...”

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
I taught them the rules, raised them with 
discipline... and forged a strong, 
beautiful team fit for the elegant spirit 
of cricket!

text_block_list.name: Gentlemanly Janitor
text_block_list.text:
And today, we invite another Umamusume 
team... for our first and final match...!
choice_data_list:
(Such intense drama went down without me 
realizing...?!)

text_block_list.text:
And so the match began. In contrast to her 
graceful appearance in her white uniform, 
watching her sprint with all her might in 
pursuit of the ball warmed my heart—

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: Coach... I'm so sorry! I lost...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please raise your heads.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As long as you played fair and square, 
there is no shame in defeat.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: Coach...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With that, we are dismissed. —Thank you 
for your hard work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!!

Warm applause poured over both teams for 
putting up such a fair and honorable 
fight.

text_block_list.name: Umpire
text_block_list.text: —Game set! Won by Team Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait, first I must thank my 
opponent! That was a wonderful play!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, everyone. I 
believe it was a truly splendid match.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: Coach! ...I dedicate this victory to you.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
This team was formed solely because the 
director wanted to play cricket at the Fan 
Appreciation Festival... and that's it.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
So normally, we'd probably disband today. 
But we want to keep going! We're thinking 
of making a hobby team!

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
Coach... won't you please stay on as 
well!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I decline.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
"...HUH!?!? Wait, wasn't this the part 
where you're supposed to agree with 
me...!?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but I have already 
accomplished my purpose.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As for what comes next, please feel free 
to decide and act as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Even without my presence, everyone should 
already possess the strength to accomplish 
that.

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Coach, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Team
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!!

And so, the cricket team drama that had 
unfolded without my slightest knowledge 
finally came to a close.

Afterward, Daiichi Ruby made a declaration 
of resolve toward her next goal, the 
Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To become a new symbol for my family, I 
will relentlessly pursue speed.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To all members of the media, please 
continue to keep your eyes upon us going 
forward.
(Clap clap clap...)

Daiichi Ruby handled the situation with 
poise, but occasionally seemed lost in 
thought.

After the press left, I asked her about 
it...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You asked why I decided to participate 
in today's event, correct?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
For the family's sake... and above all, to 
carry on the tradition established by 
Mother.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"And the other reason is to draw more 
attention."

As a member of the "Splendid Clan," 
Daiichi Ruby naturally draws a lot of 
attention. Even now, she turns heads, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please cast your mind back to last year. 
To that glorious era for the Tiara route.

The Oka Sho, and then the Oaks... Back 
then, countless eyes followed her every 
move, and everyone had her name on their 
lips.

Compared to back then... yes, things may 
have settled down now. It can't be helped.
choice_data_list:
It's probably the effects of the change in 
plans.

text_block_list.text:
"Compared to sprint races, Classic races 
inevitably draw much more hype. The 
difference in attention simply can't be 
helped."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am aware of that. However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
The "Splendid Clan" must always stand 
above others and be worthy of their 
admiration...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Just like today's event, let's continue to 
proactively take part in public 
appearances.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, to achieve a dazzling 
result at the Yasuda Kinen... No 
rushing—steady progress forward.
